mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline of >=0.10pp leads to negative 20d returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rise >0.3pp in 3 months is followed by positive 5d returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates robust aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to improved corporate earnings outlooks.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS (both rising >0.5% MoM) fails to produce positive 60d returns in >50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, a rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates improving supply conditions and economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-recession recovery periods, INDPRO growth of >0.5% MoM is followed by negative 20d returns in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.05 for regime-specific signal.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY >3.5% is followed by positive 60d returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market and strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth of >0.2% MoM fails to produce positive 5d returns in >50% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to near-term earnings momentum.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS (both rising >0.5% MoM) fails to produce positive 20d returns in >50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (2017=100) signals severe supply constraints and economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO <100.0 is followed by positive 5d returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 for this signal.
